# BNL Community Fixes v2.1.2

New feature: Local Build Preview.

Included in this release:

- New **Build Preview** tab in Feature Settings
- Blocks and devices appear on your screen immediately when placed, without waiting for server confirmation
- Reduces the visual delay felt when switching weapons and tools
- The server remains authoritative — incorrect placements revert automatically
- Configurable prediction timeout (default 2 s)
- Recommended only for players with high ping
- More options button on the main launcher page groups secondary tools into a separate dialog
